review_runs.summary: Selected source teaches all four future expressions with clear explanations, contextual examples, and meaningful changed-context writing. Norwegian teaching examples use valid Bokmål; negative examples are clearly labeled. Main defects: two completion items reject valid readings without sufficiently restricting meaning, one learner-facing CEFR reference, and an unglossed grammatical term. Reviewed all 16 exercises. Every exercise serves obj-future-expressions-01 through interpreting future meanings, choosing context-appropriate expressions, forming constructions correctly, or producing future-oriented messages. Focused exercises validly target individual forms or distinctions; none relies on shared topic vocabulary alone.
